add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v8.title: Add File Attachment to PDF with Aspose.Pdf
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v8.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a FileSpecification for an external file, embed it as an attachment, and save the updated document.

remove-pdf-attachment.title: Remove PDF Attachment Using Aspose.Pdf
remove-pdf-attachment.description: Shows how to load a PDF, detect embedded file attachments, delete the first attachment, and save the cleaned document with Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiple-attachments-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Multiple Attachments to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf
add-multiple-attachments-to-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, embed several files as attachments, and save the resulting document with the new embedded files.

remove-all-attachments-from-pdf__v3.title: Remove All Attachments from PDF
remove-all-attachments-from-pdf__v3.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its embedded file attachments, delete each one, and save the cleaned document.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v9.title: Add File Attachment to PDF using Aspose.Pdf
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v9.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a FileSpecification for an external file, embed it as an attachment, and save the updated document.

add-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Attachment to PDF with Aspose.Pdf
add-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a file specification from a stream, embedding the file as an attachment, and saving the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-all-attachments-from-pdf__v4.title: Remove All Attachments from a PDF
remove-all-attachments-from-pdf__v4.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, delete every embedded file attachment, and save the cleaned document.

add-multiple-file-attachments-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Multiple File Attachments to a PDF
add-multiple-file-attachments-to-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, embedding several files as attachments, and saving the updated document.

add-multiple-attachments-to-pdf__v3.title: Add Multiple Attachments to PDF using Aspose.Pdf
add-multiple-attachments-to-pdf__v3.description: Shows how to load a PDF, embed three files from streams as attachments, and save the modified document.

add-file-attachments-to-pdf__v2.title: Add File Attachments to PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
add-file-attachments-to-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create file specifications from streams with distinct descriptions, embed them as attachments, and save the updated document.

remove-all-attachments-from-pdf__v5.title: Remove All Attachments from PDF
remove-all-attachments-from-pdf__v5.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades, delete every embedded attachment, and save the cleaned document.

manage-pdf-attachments-with-pdfcontented.title: Manage PDF Attachments with PdfContentEditor
manage-pdf-attachments-with-pdfcontented.description: The example demonstrates binding a PDF with PdfContentEditor, removing all existing embedded file attachments, adding a new attachment from a file stream, and saving the updated PDF.

add-and-delete-pdf-file-attachments.title: Add and Delete File Attachments in PDF
add-and-delete-pdf-file-attachments.description: The example loads an existing PDF, adds three file attachments via the Document.EmbeddedFiles collection, then removes all attachments and saves the resulting PDF.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v10.title: Add File Attachment to PDF and Verify Embedded Files
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v10.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file attachment into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, save the document, and then enumerate the EmbeddedFiles collection to confirm the attachment.

remove-and-add-pdf-attachments.title: Remove Existing Attachments and Add New Stream Attachments to PDF
remove-and-add-pdf-attachments.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, delete all embedded file attachments, and then add new attachments from memory streams or files before saving the document.

replace-pdf-attachments-with-new-file.title: Replace PDF Attachments with a New File
replace-pdf-attachments-with-new-file.description: Shows how to load a PDF, remove all embedded file attachments, add a new file attachment, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiple-stream-attachments-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple Stream Attachments to PDF and List Embedded Files
add-multiple-stream-attachments-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed several in‑memory text files into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, save the document, and then enumerate the embedded files to display a summary.

delete-attachments-add-new-files.title: Delete All PDF Attachments and Add New Files
delete-attachments-add-new-files.description: Demonstrates how to remove every attachment from a PDF using PdfContentEditor, then add new file attachments with the Document API and save the result.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v11.title: Add File Attachment to PDF using Aspose.Pdf
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v11.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an embedded file from a memory stream with a description, adding it to the document's EmbeddedFiles collection, and saving the modified PDF.

manage-pdf-attachments-with-pdfcontented.title: Manage PDF Attachments with PdfContentEditor
manage-pdf-attachments-with-pdfcontented.description: The example shows how to bind a PDF using PdfContentEditor, add file attachments via the Document API, delete all attachments, and save the modified PDF.

replace-pdf-attachments-with-new-files.title: Replace PDF Attachments with New Files
replace-pdf-attachments-with-new-files.description: The example loads a PDF, removes any existing embedded file attachments, adds three new file attachments, and saves the updated document.

add-attachment-to-pdf-and-list-embedded-.title: Add Attachment to PDF and List Embedded Files
add-attachment-to-pdf-and-list-embedded-.description: Shows how to open an existing PDF, embed a file as an attachment using FileSpecification, enumerate all embedded files, and save the updated document.

delete-attachments-add-new-pdf-attachmen.title: Delete Existing Attachments and Add New File Attachments to PDF
delete-attachments-add-new-pdf-attachmen.description: Demonstrates how to remove all existing attachments from a PDF using PdfContentEditor.DeleteAttachments, then add new file attachments with the Document API and save the result.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf-and-list-embe.title: Add File Attachment to PDF and List Embedded Files
add-file-attachment-to-pdf-and-list-embe.description: The example loads an existing PDF, attaches a text file as an embedded file with a description, saves the modified PDF, and then enumerates all embedded attachments.
